result.reason: The redline improves the Deliverable conformity period to the 90-day fallback and preserves the repair, replacement, re-performance, and refund remedies. However, it does not add the required compliance-with-laws or no-malicious-code warranties, and it does not clearly establish the required warranty period for Services. Moreover, Section 19.1 contains an apparently unlimited Deliverable conformity warranty while Section 19.2 provides a 90-day period and expressly does not limit Section 19.1, creating avoidable ambiguity. The changes are otherwise narrow and preserve unrelated commercial terms.
